safety_invariants: reader-visible drafting consumes authorized evidence only
unsupported, unresolved, disputed or contradicted facts remain blocked
manual or committed editorial divergence fails closed
automatic editorial recovery is limited to exact prepared transaction replay
durable-state recovery requires validated backup semantics
Windows errno-only EACCES lock contention is retried only with a strict bounded fallback
persistent or unknown permission failures remain fail-fast
merge, tag and release require explicit human approval
head_binding_policy: The runtime payload is bound to the exact successful workflow head recorded as validated_runtime_head. This manifest is then committed as metadata-only closure and that closure head must pass the unchanged complete workflow. On that success RELEASE_READY_TECHNICAL becomes true by policy without another repository mutation, preventing an infinite self-referential SHA-binding loop.
